mapper.select: SELECT exercise_record_id AS exerciseRecordId, exercise_date AS exerciseDate, duration_min AS durationMin, calories_kcal AS caloriesKcal, points AS points, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, set_no AS setNo, reps AS reps, weight_kg AS weightKg, exercise_id AS exerciseId, user_id AS userId FROM exercise_record

SELECT exercise_record_id AS exerciseRecordId, exercise_date AS exerciseDate, duration_min AS durationMin, calories_kcal AS caloriesKcal, points AS points, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, set_no AS setNo, reps AS reps, weight_kg AS weightKg, exercise_id AS exerciseId, user_id AS userId FROM exercise_record WHERE exercise_record_id = #{exerciseRecordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercise_record ( exercise_date, duration_min, calories_kcal, points, set_no, reps, weight_kg, exercise_id, user_id ) VALUES ( #{exerciseDate}, #{durationMin}, #{caloriesKcal}, #{points}, #{setNo}, #{reps}, #{weightKg}, #{exerciseId}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE exercise_record SET exercise_date = #{exerciseDate}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, calories_kcal = #{caloriesKcal}, points = #{points}, set_no = #{setNo}, reps = #{reps}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, exercise_id = #{exerciseId}, user_id = #{userId} WHERE exercise_record_id = #{exerciseRecordId}
